% Independent MacTeX coordinate/node-box probe, not a TikZKit fixture.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\pointreport}[2]{%
  \pgfextractx{\dimen0}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}%
  \pgfextracty{\dimen2}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}%
  \typeout{POINT #1.#2: \the\dimen0,\the\dimen2}}
\newcommand{\smallaxis}[1]{%
  \typeout{CASE #1}%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[width=4cm,height=2cm,xmin=0,xmax=1,ymin=0,ymax=1,#1]
    \addplot coordinates {(0,0) (1,1)};
    \coordinate (lo) at (axis description cs:0,0);
    \coordinate (hi) at (axis description cs:1,1);
  \end{axis}
  \pointreport{lo}{center}\pointreport{hi}{center}
  \end{tikzpicture}}
\newcommand{\tickaxis}[1]{%
  \typeout{CASE tick #1}%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[width=5cm,height=4cm,xmin=0,xmax=1,ymin=0,ymax=1,
    xtick={0},xticklabels={2012\\2956},ytick=\empty,
    tick label style={font=\footnotesize},xticklabel style={name=tick,#1}]
  \end{axis}
  \pointreport{tick}{north west}\pointreport{tick}{south east}
  \pointreport{tick}{base}\pointreport{tick}{center}
  \end{tikzpicture}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\smallaxis{axis lines=middle}
\smallaxis{axis lines=box}
\smallaxis{axis lines=middle,scale only axis}
\tickaxis{align=none}
\tickaxis{align=center}
\tickaxis{align=left}
\tickaxis{align=center,line width=.8pt}
\setbox0=\hbox{\footnotesize 20\,\%}%
\typeout{TEXT percent: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}%
\setbox0=\hbox{\footnotesize 20\%}%
\typeout{TEXT percent without space: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}%
\foreach \axisstyle in {left,box}{%
\typeout{CASE range \axisstyle}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[axis lines=\axisstyle,xlabel=$x$,ylabel=$y$,title=Curve,
  xlabel style={name=xl},ylabel style={name=yl},title style={name=ttl}]
\addplot+[green,mark=none,domain=0:2,samples=5] {x^2};
\coordinate (zero) at (axis cs:0,0);
\coordinate (max) at (axis cs:2,4);
\coordinate (lo) at (axis description cs:0,0);
\coordinate (hi) at (axis description cs:1,1);
\end{axis}
\pointreport{lo}{center}\pointreport{hi}{center}
\pointreport{zero}{center}\pointreport{max}{center}
\pointreport{xl}{center}\pointreport{yl}{center}\pointreport{ttl}{center}
\end{tikzpicture}}
\typeout{CASE starred label default}%
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[width=6cm,xmin=0,xmax=5,ymin=0,ymax=5,
  axis lines*=left,unit vector ratio*={1 1 1},try min ticks=5,
  ylabel=m,ylabel style={name=yl}]
\addplot[draw=none] coordinates {(0,0) (5,5)};
\end{axis}
\pointreport{yl}{center}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
